source /etc/network_turbo

pip install -e ".[torch,metrics]"

pkill -9 python
watch -n 1 nvidia-smi

nohup python eval_ocean.py   > eval_ocean.log 2>&1 &

nohup bash -c "python inference.py >> inference.log 2>&1 && shutdown -h now" &
nohup bash -c "python inference.py >> inference.log 2>&1 ; shutdown -h now" &
nohup python inference.py   > inference.log 2>&1 &

nohup bash -c "python Ranking_Pairing.py >> Ranking_Pairing.log 2>&1 ; shutdown -h now" &

mv ocean_dpo_data.json /root/autodl-tmp/target_1/LLaMA-Factory/data/
修改注册表： 编辑 /root/autodl-tmp/target_1/LLaMA-Factory/data/dataset_info.json，在里面添加以下内容（注意 JSON 格式，别漏了逗号）：
"ocean_dpo": {
  "file_name": "ocean_dpo_data.json",
  "ranking": true,
  "formatting": "sharegpt",
  "columns": {
    "messages": "conversations",
    "chosen": "chosen",
    "rejected": "rejected"
  }
}

#!/bin/bash
cd /root/autodl-tmp/target_1/LLaMA-Factory

run_dpo.sh：
# 显存清理（好习惯）
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0

echo "开始 DPO 训练..."

nohup llamafactory-cli train \
    --stage dpo \
    --do_train \
    --model_name_or_path /root/autodl-tmp/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct \
    --adapter_name_or_path /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/ocean_qwen_sft_v1 \
    --dataset ocean_dpo \
    --template qwen \
    --finetuning_type lora \
    --lora_target all \
    --output_dir /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/ocean_qwen_dpo_v1 \
    --overwrite_output_dir \
    --quantization_bit 4 \
    --per_device_train_batch_size 1 \
    --gradient_accumulation_steps 8 \
    --learning_rate 5e-6 \
    --num_train_epochs 1.0 \
    --lr_scheduler_type cosine \
    --warmup_ratio 0.1 \
    --fp16 \
    --logging_steps 5 \
    --save_steps 50 \
    --plot_loss \
    --pref_beta 0.1 \
    --pref_ftx 0 \
    --pref_loss sigmoid \
    > ../train_dpo.log 2>&1 &

echo "DPO 训练已后台启动！请查看 ../train_dpo.log"
